record.note: Scoped design review for the #5111 source change: one-module local-dev staging reuses actual receipt4/metadata/WASM validation, requires current preserved source evidence and unchanged shared recipe, retains frozen historical release bytes and never promotes candidate to release or changes CI checks. Separately versioned release metadata still requires real release build evidence and existing activation authority. This reviews the contract only, not runtime, host, release or playtest acceptance. Reviewed the concrete storage 0.2.0 local sync/check command: exact originally captured execution image, no automatic image rebuild, explicit one-module IDs and distinct versioned hash/identity paths. Default release checks remain historical and candidate receipt4 freshness remains separate; this is method documentation, not proof of production activation. 本次增量复核确认：fetcher、外部 compiler 与默认构建均应独占仓库 .tmp 内的工作目录；原子创建区分名称碰撞与实际 IO 失败，清理只作用于本次取得的目录。该约束保持 Docker 挂载、字节 hash 校验和外围发布授权边界，产品要求无需调整。本记录只确认系统合同，不代签构建、运行或发布验收。 #5548 增量独立语义复核：metadata-only targets 仅满足原 workspace 解析，真实 producer 仍由原精确两包闭包与映像内字节校验确定；helper 纳入固定 recipe 输入。批量固定不可变镜像，前后输入校验、非 root 与同层临时产物回收保持原权限。批次失败可保留真实已完成模块输出，但局部 receipt 不代表整批成功或 baseline 提升。此记录只确认合同与空间优化边界，不代签未完成的双模块/全量构建、跨宿主发布或 #5439 完整启用。
